dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: ...She should've been here by now. Is she skipping her coffee today?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: No, no way! Today's blend is her favorite flavor. She'll be here...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, if it isn't Reporter Charlotte from The Steambird!

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Waaah! Y—You scared me half to death! Didn't anyone teach you not to sneak up on people?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I only called your name like, a bunch of times.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Eh? You did? S—Sorry then... I was so focused on the report and photos, I didn't hear you...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: *sigh*... Still no sign of Clorinde, though. Is she really not coming today...?

choices.text: Lined up an interview with her?

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: You're not wrong... But if I can score the first interview with the "Champion Duelist Who Never Gives Interviews," it'll be another front-page hit!

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Of course, I'd get rejected like all the other reporters if I simply marched up to her. So...

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: I've decided to take a more roundabout approach to the problem.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: First, I worked out a complete dossier, including all her usual haunts and routines.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Next, I'll camp out in those spots at specific times to await the perfect "chance encounter."

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: I'm even learning how to play tabletop games so I can visit the Tabletop Troupe in a few days and play through a new script with them. And maybe... even be the Game Master!

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: If I can be the Game Master for a game Clorinde is in, I could use the role to build up my rapport with her...

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Of course, I'd never ask inappropriate questions during a session, and I never use off-the-record statements in my reports. Ethically-sourced quotes only!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Be careful when you run into Navia...

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Navia? I've heard she's an avid gamer! What's the issue?

choices.text: You should practice voicing sentient doors.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Wait... What? Is that the kind of thing a GM has to deal with? Ah, that's nothing! Talking is what we journalists do best.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: If I ever get stumped by something, I'll dazzle them with my professionally honed spin techniques. Nobody'll be the wiser!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Is... Is that how you normally handle things? Wait, so when...

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: No, no way! When I speak with you, it comes straight from the heart! There's nothing I can't say to you.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Whoa! Gotta run, I need to get to the Hotel Debord! Clorinde might be on her way to buy some cake there this very second!

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: #See you later, {NICKNAME}! And don't forget — I want an exclusive interview with you next time we get the chance!

choices.text: And how to keep her from interrogating every frog that hops by.
I thought she didn't do interviews.
